adapter_evidence.row_semantics: inline 0x18-byte FactionItem rows; only the uint32 faction identity at +0x00 is read
adapter_evidence.producer_limit: The leaf getter is folded and has multiple direct callsites. No exact producer/writer is claimed by this package.

capture_seam.owner: GetTargetingFactions GUI callback immediately after the exact leaf getter

each_capture_requires: admission before the first targeting-state read
captured row count equals admitted campaign-root player_targeting_faction_count
two equal faction-id and target-character-id copies from inline 0x18-byte rows
equal proof epoch, revision, date, player identity and campaign-root targeting count after the second copy
every faction id resolves and round-trips
every target CharacterID resolves and full-generation round-trips
every target CharacterID equals the admitted player identity
transaction.publication: owned faction/target-character identity pairs sorted by faction id plus the admitted campaign-root count are published with an odd/even generation; any failure retains the previous generation

pointer_boundary.process_local_addresses: container and row addresses are used only during the synchronous capture and are never published

evidence_limit: FACTION4-CORE implements the private/default-off same-admission target CharacterID and campaign-root count gates with deterministic fixtures. Paused live capture, member vectors, type, war, power/discontent and public MCP/schema promotion remain unproven.

same_admission_join.count_gate: FactionsWindow+0x144 row count equals admitted campaign-root count
same_admission_join.target_gate: every resolved CFaction+0x40 CharacterID equals admitted player_character_id
